constraints: History may move a candidate by at most one route level in this stage.
Aspiration history only applies to the oral_aspiration_or_anaerobe family.
In v1, a prior aspiration episode alone is context; a durable anatomic risk is required for Context-to-Priority.
Context-to-Priority also requires a top-three per-test rank or analytical reproducibility.
Audit-to-Context is limited to strict aspiration anaerobes with rank at most ten or reproducible signal, and at most two representatives per patient.
History never creates a candidate and never directly creates Picked.
Evidence consumed by this stage is recorded and cannot be counted again as an independent High-to-Picked axis.
A low-confidence phenotype NO means not established; it does not negate direct structured source evidence.
The policy is answer blind and does not read benchmark labels.
